description.value:
Duration constant

Each time THE LEAK deals its damage to a creature, that creature also takes a cumulative -1 status penalty to AC, to a maximum of -4. The penalty ends on a creature that THE LEAK has not touched since the end of your last turn. This requires no action and no save, exactly as THE LEAK does.

cinderfall.incomplete: Cumulative -1 AC (max -4) to whatever THE LEAK hits -- no rule element auto-increments a custom counter round over round outside a named condition's own badge-increment or a SpecialResource (NOSTACK); THE LEAK itself (a passive always-on drip to a player-chosen enemy each turn) is also unbuildable, same reasoning as Faint Leak.
